enrichment.summary: The board adopts Resolution No. 2021-0030, which formally declares the results of the Measure Y school bond election held November 3, 2020. The text gives no dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Certification of Measure "Y" - District's General Bond Election Results - November 3, 2020

enrichment.headline: Puts one oversight committee over bond Measures B, J and Y and amends Board Bylaw 9131
enrichment.summary: The board assigns monitoring and reporting of spending from facilities bond Measures B, J and Y to a single citizens' oversight committee, renames it the Measures B, J, and Y Independent Citizens' School Facilities Bonds Oversight Committee, and amends Board Bylaw 9131 to match. The text gives no dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Establishment - District Independent Citizens School Facilities Bond Oversight Committee - As the Oversight Committee for Measure "Y" - Amending Board Bylaw 9131 Accordingly

enrichment.headline: Adds $64,187.07 for materials testing and inspection on the Emerson softball field project
enrichment.summary: Consolidated Engineering Laboratories will do additional materials testing and construction inspection for the Girls' Softball Field Project. The amendment adds $64,187.07, including a $5,835.19 contingency, raising the agreement limit from $30,000 to $94,187.07.

enrichment.headline: Adds $9,417.05 and 120 days to One Workplace's Glenview furniture contract
enrichment.summary: One Workplace is supplying new furniture for the Glenview New Construction Project. This amendment adds $9,417.05, raising the agreement limit from $607,405.23 to $616,822.28, and extends the term by 120 days to April 30, 2021.
